title: Allocate exact quota by tier priority and request order
instruction: Complete allocate_quota(total, requests, tier_caps) using exact Decimal arithmetic. total is a finite non-negative Decimal with at most two fractional digits. tier_caps is a non-empty ordered mapping from unique non-empty tier strings to positive two-decimal Decimals; mapping order defines tier priority. requests is a list of exact id, tier, amount records with unique non-empty IDs, known tiers, and positive two-decimal Decimal amounts. Allocate by tier priority then original request order, capped by each request, its tier cap, and the global total. Include every request ID with a Decimal allocation, return exact allocations and remaining, validate all inputs before calculation, and never mutate caller data. Add tests and no dependencies.

author_metadata.notes: Wave-4 numeric lineage using exact decimals, two nested caps, and deterministic priority ordering.
